notes: Per-proposition content-rights matrix (control-13, ADR 0008/0010). Every proposition (survey question) shown in the app derives its wording and party-vote positions from a LOCKED They Vote For You API v1 snapshot (data/snapshots/tvfy/<election>/v<version>/). This register records, per election, the content-rights class that governs those propositions and the OpenAustralia Foundation (OAF) content-permission position. scripts/check-proposition-rights.mjs (blocking, Data CI group) proves every proposition maps to a locked snapshot policy and to a defined rights class, so no proposition can ship without a settled content-rights position. The class must match the rights register's vote-positions domain (data/rights/rights-classes.json). Approval of this matrix is recorded as EV-TVFY-SNAPSHOT-LOCK in docs/legal/control-register.json.

elections.oafPermissionBasis: Proposition wording and party positions are factual parliamentary-vote data obtained from the They Vote For You API v1 under the ODbL and used with ODbL attribution. No separate OpenAustralia Foundation content permission is required.
